_meta.description: Flagged irregularities and unverified items. Published on the Flagged for Review page. None of these block the merge (per the user's instruction). 'Needs review' means the user should decide.

flags.title: Category commission rate unverified (blank on all rows)
flags.detail: The official Standard Commission Income schedule is behind an Amazon sign-in. Third-party sites disagree (Kitchen is listed at 4.5% by one and 5% by another), so no rate was entered. Earnings and commission potential cannot be calculated until the rate is read from the schedule in an authenticated Associates account.
flags.action: Sign in to Associates Central, read the rate for the category Amazon assigns to these products, and send it for entry.

flags.title: Prices and star ratings withheld from the public site
flags.detail: Participation Requirements Section 2(b) allows prices and availability to be shown only if Amazon serves the link or the data comes from Creators API / PA API. Section 3(t) bars star ratings and review data unless obtained the same way. The verification read prices and ratings, but they are not published. The pricing and rating analysis the brief asks for therefore cannot be shown on a static site.
flags.action: Decide whether to (a) apply for PA-API / Creators API access, which requires review of its license terms (not reviewed in this pass), or (b) accept price and rating fields as withheld.

flags.title: Associates tag not visible in the resolved links
flags.detail: All three short links resolve to Amazon product URLs with tracking parameters (lv, channelId, plpRedirect, btn_ref) but no 'tag=' parameter. Commission attribution to the user's Associates ID therefore cannot be confirmed from the page.
flags.action: Confirm in Associates Central that each link was generated under the user's Associates ID. Send the tagged canonical URL if the short links do not carry the tag.

flags.title: Short-link codes do not match the ASINs they resolve to
flags.detail: The codes B04G1MEwY, B02NbDxp3 and B00hJ57DV are not ASINs. They resolve to B0CDY277D3, B09B7SB46R and B08DKYBTPH. The ASIN from the resolved URL is used everywhere on the site.
flags.action: Confirm each resolved ASIN is the intended product.

flags.title: Brand for P2 is ambiguous
flags.detail: The Emeril product page lists 'Visit the Emeril Store' and shows the byline 'Innovation IQ'. The brand is therefore left unresolved rather than assumed to be Emeril Lagasse.
flags.action: Confirm the brand/manufacturer from the product's 'Product information' section or the seller page.

flags.title: Capacity units differ between title and specification
flags.detail: P1 title says '6 Quart' but the specification says '6 liters'. P2 title says '26QT' but the specification says '24.6 liters'. Units were not converted, so the two values were left exactly as listed.
flags.action: Confirm the capacity the manufacturer states (quarts or liters) before using it in comparisons.

flags.title: Colour differs between title and specification (P1)
flags.detail: The title ends in 'Black'; the specification table lists 'Black, Gray'.
flags.action: Confirm the colour option the user intends to promote.

flags.title: P3 is a size-variant family
flags.detail: The P3 page offers size options of 6, 8 and 9 quarts. The short link resolves to the 8-quart variant (ASIN B08DKYBTPH, with variation parameter th=1). Capacity values on the site are for the 8-quart variant only.
flags.action: Confirm whether the user wants the 8-quart variant or the family.

flags.title: Snapshot was taken for a US delivery location
flags.detail: The product-page snapshots were read with a US delivery location set. This does not establish the user's location or intended storefront. Prices and availability may vary by delivery location; no location-specific prices or availability are published.
flags.action: Confirm amazon.com is the intended storefront before promotion; if another marketplace is intended, verify its product links and local program terms.

flags.title: Competitor carousel on P2 is labelled 'Sponsored'
flags.detail: The 'Customers who viewed this item also viewed' section on the P2 page is labelled 'Sponsored'. Competitor ASINs listed for P2 may therefore be paid placements, not organic recommendations.
flags.action: Treat P2's competitor list as a sponsored signal, not as organic competition data.

flags.title: Verification method may conflict with Amazon Conditions of Use
flags.detail: The Conditions of Use licence excludes collecting and using product listings, descriptions or prices, and excludes data mining and robots. This verification read product pages with an automated retrieval tool. The site keeps only identifiers, brand, category and a few specification fields, and does not publish prices or ratings. Scaling this approach (for example, automated product research) would need legal review.
flags.action: Review with counsel before any automated product research. Prefer PA-API / Creators API data or manual entry.

flags.title: AI content automation is restricted by Amazon Conditions of Use
flags.detail: The Conditions of Use bar using AI-generated content from Amazon Services to develop or improve large language or machine learning models. The planned AI article generation has therefore NOT been built. It must be reviewed before it is connected to any Amazon-derived data.
flags.action: Decide the data sources for AI-generated articles and get a compliance review before automation.

flags.title: Earlier Pages workflow failure (resolved; root redirect is used)
flags.detail: An earlier 'Deploy static site to GitHub Pages' workflow failed before creating jobs. The repository's Pages source is main root (/); the root index redirects to docs/index.html. The failure was resolved by replacing the deployment workflow with site checks and confirming the subsequent Pages deployment succeeded (deployment details are in COORDINATION.md).
flags.action: See COORDINATION.md for the successful deployment and site-check run links.

flags.title: Prior prototype records superseded
flags.detail: The prototype pages from earlier sessions (root index.html, products.html, insights.html, flagged.html) held blank product records and an unverified status. They are replaced by the verified records in this site (git history keeps them).

flags.title: Trend, popularity and conversion signals are unverified
flags.detail: The product pages show Amazon badges (for example 'Amazon's Choice' and 'bought in past month') and rank-like signals. These are not published, because reuse of Amazon-displayed sales and review metrics was not confirmed (F-02). No official source provides verified trend or conversion data for these products, so trend and conversion fields are blank.
flags.action: Provide an official data source (for example, PA-API) or accept blank fields.

flags.title: Creators API / PA API license terms not reviewed
flags.detail: The Program Policies incorporate an 'Associates Program IP License and Usage Requirements' section that governs Creators API and PA API use. It was not read line by line in this pass, so no API integration is claimed.
flags.action: Read the IP License section before any API work.
